title: Transport Occupations Express Entry Category 2026: Pilots, Mechanics & Aviation Workers
excerpt: Transport Occupations Express Entry Category 2026: Pilots, Mechanics & Aviation Workers By Anuj Sengar, Licensed RCIC R515178 · Founder, Can X GlobalPublished: February 2026 · 8 min read Express Entry Transport Occupations (Aviation): 2026 Guide Canada’s skies are not short of passengers. They are short of the people who keep aircraft in the air and flying safely. The new 2026 Express Entry Transport Occupations category is Canada’s immigration response to a workforce crisis in aviation that has been building since the COVID-19 pandemic disrupted the sector and never fully recovered.
author: Anuj Sengar
